As a result of the committed transfer of head lease and the operating assets of Browns Ari Resort (Pvt) Ltd, a wholly owned subsidiary of Eden Hotel
Lanka PLC, management has assessed that there is uncertainty over the recoverability of its investment as at 31 March 2026. Accordingly, Eden
Hotel Lanka PLC has recognised an impairment loss of Rs. 260,732,302 in the Statement of Profit or Loss.
